{{Quote|As soon as the base is destroyed Alpha group will report back to their command ship.|An [[Imperial briefing officer]], in reference to ''Control''|audio=BriefingOfficer-AlphaCommandShip-TIEFighter.flac|<ref name="TIE Fighter" />}}
'''''Control''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] within an Imperial simulation. In the simulation, it served as a [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] for the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Alpha Squadron]] during an [[Bombing of the Rebel outpost|attack]] on a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Unidentified Rebel outpost|outpost]], which would ultimately become a victory for the Imperial forces.

==Description==
As a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], ''Control'' had a length of 150 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="Sourcebook" /> a hull rated 50 [[RU/Legends|RU]], and a maximum speed of 20 [[Megalight|MGLT]].<ref name="TIE Fighter" /> Its armament included two [[Turret/Legends|turret]]-mounted dual [[H9 turbolaser/Legends|H9 turbolasers]], with one on the dorsal side of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] and one on the ventral side.<ref name="Armament" /> The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] also had a certain level of shielding along with [[Color/Legends|gray]] plating with red stripes with an orange tint.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />

==History==
[[File:RebelOutpost-TIEFighter.png|thumb|right|280px|The Rebel outpost was attacked by ''Control''{{'s}} TIE bombers.]]
During a simulated [[Bombing of the Rebel outpost|attack]] on a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Unidentified Rebel outpost|outpost]], ''Control'' served as a [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] for a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] called [[Alpha Squadron]], which was assigned to destroy the outpost. It also served as a command ship for the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] ''[[Walker 1]]'', which could reload the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] if they ran out of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] warheads.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />

The [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Cavalry]]'' would stand in for ''Control'' in case the corvette was destroyed during the simulated bombing. During the attack, some of the outpost's ships fought back against the Imperial vessels, and ''Control'' itself was attacked by [[Transport/Legends|transport]] group ''[[Axet]]'', although the transports were quickly destroyed by the TIE bombers. After the outpost was destroyed, the TIE bombers returned to ''Control''. The simulation was featured in the Imperial combat training simulator, where TIE bomber [[TIE pilot|pilots]] could test their skills with the torpedo warhead.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Control'' first appeared in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], a [[1994]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[Totally Games]]. The ship is featured in the third combat chamber mission for the TIE bomber, titled "Torpedo Run."<ref name="TIE Fighter" />
